required: one otherwise plain unpanelled leaf and complete slim squared casing
exactly one deep near-black full-height recessed channel at far left
exactly one narrow warm natural-wood accent band below the hardware
exactly two thin dark borders around that one band
exactly one round handle rosette, one straight horizontal lever and one separate round key escutcheon
no extra panel, seam, groove, line, band, channel, hardware, text, badge, brand or logo
signature.nativeDetailInspection: All nine accepted files preserve the one-band signature, band placement and borders, full-height channel, hardware count and placement, full casing and NO_LOGO policy.

framing.decision: Every accepted door fills at least 97.40% of the usable width and no measured margin exceeds 10 pixels. Native inspection confirms every zero-edge contact preserves complete flat posts, lintel and bottom endpoints rather than cropping them.
